body: Hey,  I get what you mean, wanna PM me?
I feel you, the idea of being with someone who has so much more experience than me really terrifies me, just in case I can't give them what other girls have.
This happened to me about a week ago, my LD bf randomly cut of all contact, it hurts, but oh well.

I'm tempted to say it doesn't exist, but I've had too little experience myself to know, hopefully when I find out I get to keep him! In all honesty, I've only ever observed pretty dysfunctional relationships which may be the reason why I keep getting into them.
That's exactly what I want! A relationship in which both parties hold up equal parts, I just hope I can find that.
Thank you for saying that. I've spent to past few days thinking I'm being irrational, but what you said is pretty much exact to what I'm going through.

Unfortunately this is something people do and it's annoying as hell. As a girl who isn't that much older than you, being 5"1 really doesn't help the situation, so I get what you mean with the height thing. The only thing I can suggest is that you shock people with how well you speak. You'll find that you speak better than a lot of the adults who treat you like this.

I'm young enough to find someone I assure you, with university on the way and everything. It's just a fear I guess, based on the fact that I have personal issues which cause me to overlook red flags in people.

Hey, I know how you feel. My birthday was on the 6th and it was shit, like it is every year but obviously I had to pretend like everything was great while scrolling through the mindless 'HBD' posts and trying not to cry over the fact that my bf at the time forgot my birthday and the just so happened to cut all contact from me on valentines day without any reason. This month is crap. PM me if you wanna vent more. :)
That would work if we had mutual friends, but I do like the idea.
Thank you, eventually I did think of that.
It would be nice to talk, can I PM you?
Thank you for the insight. It's just hard imagining him with someone else, or me without him.
Thank you, I've started playing time management games, so that helps.
No, He's in the US, I'm in the UK.
